# Which crops should fill your beds?

> Market garden bed planner for small vegetable and flower farms. Enter your crops, beds, season and labor and get the crop mix that earns the most, what one more bed-foot, labor hour or buyer is worth, and a simulated range. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
